frozen_decision.estimator_parallelism: process-parallel only; the kernel is element-wise numpy ufuncs and axis reductions with no BLAS call on any path
frozen_decision.rationale: This is an Apple A18 Pro: 2 performance cores and 4 efficiency cores, no SMT. Adding workers pushes work onto efficiency cores, which consume far more CPU-seconds for the same computation: measured CPU inflation 1.45x at 2 workers and 1.79x at 4, for wall speedups of only 1.15x and 1.75x. CPU-hours are the CAPPED resource (12.0 h), so parallelism here buys wall time by spending the budget that gates the campaign. One worker minimises the capped resource, keeps the CPU-to-wall ratio at 0.93 so the accounting is honest, and makes per-block CPU attributable to a single process.

purpose: freeze the worker/thread configuration before Stage-0
